title: War mechanic: tie, burn, flip, award
requirements: Use the single-war fixture: 4♠ versus 4♦, three face-down burns each, 9♦ versus A♦, Player 2 collects 10.
Show the initial two cards stay in the pot while six burns and two deciding cards are added.
Keep burn faces hidden in the rendered scene even though the fixture records identities for validation.
Export a four-panel poster as well as a 12-second motion; a repeat-tie arrow may connect to DIA-09 but must not be called a recursive function.
For the section-10 award cut, move pot cards one at a time in stored play order into the winner’s bottom; expose this as the award-to-bottom variant.
beats: 9–12 s: panel 4, ten cards append to Player 2.
checks: There are three face-down cards per player, not three total.
The deciding pair is additional to the burns.
Final counts are Player 1=21, Player 2=31, pot=0 from a 26/26 start.
No short-hand case is claimed to be covered by the ordinary example.
